author: Naumann, 1840
habitat: 해안의 염수 지역, 만, 강어귀, 섬, 바닷가, 개펄
summary: 해안의 짠물 지역과 만, 강어귀, 섬, 바닷가, 개펄에 사는 큰 갈매기이다. 알래스카에서는 큰 둥지를, 그 남쪽 지역에서는 그보다 작은 둥지를 틀고 5월 말~7월에 담황색 알 2~3개를 낳는다. 알은 26~28일 만에 깨고, 새끼는 깨어난 뒤 35~54일이면 날 수 있으며, 완전한 어른이 되기까지 4년이 걸리고 수명은 20년이다. 북태평양의 알래스카에서 워싱턴주에 걸쳐 분포한다.

art.subject: Glaucous-winged Gull (Larus glaucescens), adult in winter plumage, as seen on Korean coasts from December to March: head and neck white with diffuse grey-brown smudging, heaviest on the hindneck; mantle and upperwing pale grey; primaries the same pale grey as the mantle or slightly darker, with white tips and small white mirrors and no black anywhere on the wingtip; underparts and tail white. Bill large, deep and yellow with a red spot near the tip of the lower mandible; iris dark brown; orbital ring purplish-pink; legs deep pink.
art.pose: standing on a shoreline rock, side view
art.scene: Korean coastal bay in winter with a rocky shore and a tidal flat at a river mouth, cold grey light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing: pale grey mantle and folded wings with grey, not black, primaries tipped white, grey-brown smudged head and hindneck, white body, heavy yellow bill with red spot, pink legs
adult, head detail in side view: dark brown iris, purplish-pink orbital ring, deep yellow bill with a red spot near the tip of the lower mandible
adult in flight, seen from above: uniform pale grey wings, outer primaries grey with white tips and mirrors and no black, white tail
art.build: Large, heavy gull, 60–68cm, bigger and bulkier than a Black-tailed Gull and about the size of a Vega Gull, with a rounded head, thick neck and deep chest. Bill heavy and deep with a pronounced angle on the lower mandible. Legs fairly short, pink. At rest the wingtips project only a short distance beyond the tail. In flight broad, rounded wings, pale grey above, the outer primaries grey with white tips, so the wingtip looks only slightly darker than the rest of the wing.
avoid: Do not paint black wingtips; that is Vega Gull or Slaty-backed Gull. The Glaucous-winged Gull's primaries are grey like the mantle.
Do not paint pure white primaries and a pale yellow iris; that is Glaucous Gull (Larus hyperboreus).
Do not paint a pale yellow eye; the iris is dark brown.
Do not paint yellow legs; they are pink.
Do not paint a dark slate-grey mantle (Slaty-backed Gull).
